entry.title: chore: tell a broken language pack from the wrong one
entry.content:
chore: tell a broken language pack from the wrong one

When the pair is not English, the Test button also translates the English word
through the same pair. If the English word comes back correct while the source
one does not, the model in use is not the one that was asked for.

entry.title: fix: test the offline translator with a word it can actually read
entry.content:
fix: test the offline translator with a word it can actually read

The Test button always sent the English "lighthouse", so with the pair set to
French it fed a French-to-Ukrainian model an English word and Chrome answered
"Other generic failures occurred". Every language in the table now carries a
sample word, and the button uses the one for the source language.

A device translation that fails also marks the pair as not ready again, so the
extension stops treating a broken pack as usable.

entry.title: fix: two defects found by a 100-sentence evaluation
entry.content:
fix: two defects found by a 100-sentence evaluation

Ran 100 word-in-sentence cases through the extension and read every answer.
86 were right, and two defects showed up repeatedly:

- a short candidate could not match its own inflected form, so "бас" lost to
  the derived adjective "басовий" even though the plain translation was
  already correct. Short words may now take an ending (but "рак" is still not
  "ракета"), and among stem matches the form closest to the one used in the
  sentence wins.
- the window diff kept three-letter function words, turning "flu shot" into
  "щеплення від"; leftovers now need four letters.

The cases and the harness are kept so the heuristic can be re-measured:
scripts/sense-eval.mjs with tests/fixtures/sense-cases.json.

entry.title: fix: a word whose sense is not in the dictionary at all
entry.content:
fix: a word whose sense is not in the dictionary at all

Selecting "facing" in a sentence gave "облицювання": the dictionary offers
only nominal senses for that form, so there was no candidate to match and the
bubble kept the sense-blind translation.

When no candidate fits, the sentence is now asked directly: a window of two
words on each side is translated with and without the selected word, and what
the translation loses is the reading in context. Measured, not guessed - a whole
sentence is useless (the translator rebuilds the missing word) and one neighbour
is too little ("run for office" falls back to the literal "бігти"). A leftover
that is just the usual translation is rejected, so "lighthouse" stays "маяк".

facing -> стикалися, run -> балотуватися, light -> розпалити, book -> забронюйте,
while bat, spring, harbor and lighthouse keep the answers they already had.
These readings are inflected forms, so they stay in the bubble and never reach a
card, which still takes lemmas only.

entry.title: fix: a language pack that landed is not a failed download
entry.content:
fix: a language pack that landed is not a failed download

Chrome can reject Translator.create() right after installing the pack, which
left the settings showing "ready, works offline" next to a download error. The
state is now what decides: if availability says available afterwards, the
download counts as done. The offscreen document retries create() once for the
same reason, and a Test button translates a word through the on-device model so
the whole offline path can be verified in one click.

entry.title: feat: sense in context and on-device translation fallback
entry.content:
feat: sense in context and on-device translation fallback

- Selecting a word now translates the sentence around it and picks the
  dictionary sense that shows up in that translation, so "bat" on a baseball
  page gives the bat you swing. The usual meaning stays on a second line, and
  the same sense goes first on the card built by the Free provider.
- The gtx parser keeps the candidate senses (term, back-translations, score)
  that dt=bd already returned and the old code threw away.
- Chrome's built-in Translator API runs in a new offscreen document and answers
  when the online endpoint cannot be reached; the language pack is downloaded
  from the options page, which is the only context with a user gesture.
- ping only reads the cached availability, so opening the popup never creates
  the offscreen document; the document closes after five idle minutes.
- e2e now degrades to a clear SKIP when Anki is not running.

entry.title: feat: offline queue so cards can be added while Anki is closed
entry.content:
feat: offline queue so cards can be added while Anki is closed

- A card is generated in full even when AnkiConnect is unreachable and parked
  in IndexedDB (media as Blobs, ~150 KB per card, 300 max); it is written to
  Anki on a five-minute alarm, at browser start, or from the new button in the
  popup and in Settings > General.
- The duplicate check and the note type are resolved when the card is written,
  not when it is queued; each item remembers the Anki profile it was meant for
  and waits for that profile.
- Fix: an empty deck coming from a popup that had not finished its first ping
  fell through the ?? fallback and reached AnkiConnect as an empty deck name.
- Adds the alarms and unlimitedStorage permissions; version 2.1.0.

entry.title: feat: keyless Free provider and Pro tier unlocked by promo codes
entry.content:
feat: keyless Free provider and Pro tier unlocked by promo codes

- Free provider (now the default): cards built without any API key from
  Google Translate dictionary data (translations, part of speech,
  synonyms, definitions, examples), dictionaryapi.dev (IPA, definitions,
  examples for English) and the Tatoeba corpus (example sentences with
  translations); the structured request now carries word, context,
  languages and generation settings so non-LLM adapters can work

  etymology slots on cards, TTS audio for every example sentence, three
  card themes for the built-in note type, parallel additions in List
  mode (2 on Pro, 3 on Founder)
- built-in note type gains Mnemonic, Etymology and ExamplesAudio fields;
  existing installs are upgraded in place (fields added, templates
  refreshed)
- options UI: Free provider, Pro block, theme picker, promo code entry
  and batch concurrency; 26 new strings in all 12 locales
- e2e adds a real card through the Free provider with no key

entry.title: feat: Anki Quick Add v2
entry.content:
feat: Anki Quick Add v2

Chrome extension that turns a typed or selected word into a complete Anki
card via AnkiConnect: translation, transcription, part of speech, examples,
synonyms and grammar notes from the LLM provider of the user's choice
(OpenAI, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible endpoints and more), pronunciation audio
(dictionary, Wiktionary, Google TTS) and a Wikipedia image with attribution.

- built-in note type plus field mapping for any existing note type
- popup with instant translation preview, batch mode and history
- context menu and opt-in selection bubble with instant translation
- editor window to review and regenerate before adding
- duplicate policies, CEFR level, ~40 language pairs, settings sync and
  JSON export/import
- UI localised into 12 languages
- Vite + Preact + TypeScript, unit tests, Playwright e2e against the
  built extension
